scene.joint: world-to-body revolute about world Y; body origin and both joint anchors initially at origin
scene.collision: none, no shape or contact detector; this isolates joint drive and reset

common_solver.integrator: default Euler; resolved full config saved

common_run.control_schedule: PD target +1 rad for steps0..39; -1 rad for steps40..79; target velocity0, explicit effort0. dt0.005s;0.4s total.
common_run.sample: initial state plus every output state; save body_q, body_qd, joint_q, joint_qd, joint_lambdas_tau, body_qdd, control arrays, status fields, internal applied body wrench and time
common_run.performance: timing metadata only, no performance ranking
common_run.instrumentation: Read-only Python wrappers around selected original PADMM _step/_step_accel delegate exactly once then export pre/post arrays for every active iteration. No kernel, model, source, return value, or arithmetic modification. After terminal stop, skip export of subsequent no-op loop calls. Export status after each outer step; initial status deliberately absent/NaN placeholders with defined mask.

baseline.purpose: Reproduce legacy strict saturated PD and validate passive observation against both old baseline repeats.

budget1000.purpose: Distinguish insufficient 200-iteration budget from persistent plateau under unchanged strict tolerances.

compl1e6.purpose: Isolate complementarity stopping tolerance only; always also score original strict gates, never label relaxed stop a strict convergence solution.

noaccel.purpose: Test acceleration/restart path involvement with all tolerances and budget fixed.

noprecondition.purpose: Test diagonal scaling involvement with fixed strict stopping tolerances and budget.

evidence_criteria.residual_reconstruction_roundoff: Per iteration NumPy float64 recomputation; allowed difference 64*float32_eps times sum of absolute expression terms plus 1e-12. For r_p use P*(abs(x)+abs(y)), r_d invP*(abs(eta*dx)+abs(rho*dy)), r_c sum of abs gap*directional velocity terms. Additional float32 reconstruction retained. Never round residuals before boolean stopping check.

residual_definitions.r_d: max_i abs((eta*(x_i-x_previous_i)+rho*(y_i-y_input_i))/P_i), physical constraint velocity. Accelerated y_input=y_hat before iteration; nonaccelerated y_input=y_p.
residual_definitions.r_c: max bounded rows abs((x-lower)*max(z,0)+(upper-x)*max(-z,0)); preconditioned bounds and x,z scaling cancel, units J. No contacts/limits in this scene.
residual_definitions.stop: iterations>1 and all three terminal residuals <= actual float32 configured tolerances
residual_definitions.strict_stop: Same rule against all 1e-7 regardless of variant configured tolerance.

saved_iteration_channels: roundoff/ULP diagnostics derived only after run

diagnostic_classification.insufficient_budget_supported: Strict converged fraction increases with1000 budget and previously failing steps pass all original1e-7 residual gates; physical gates also pass. State trajectory changes must be reported.
diagnostic_classification.persistent_plateau: For steps0,1,39,40,41,79 report final20 active iterations range, exact-unchanged and distinct state counts; flag <=5% residual change over last20 with no strict stop. Longer budget median terminal rc ratio >=0.8 supports persistence, not proof of impossibility.
diagnostic_classification.precision_consistent: Independently matched residuals; plateau/short cycle; record x-bound gap in float32 ULP and whether rho*(y-x) is <0.5 ULP(z). Such evidence supports float32 quantization sensitivity but cannot prove a universal floor without matched higher-precision implementation.
diagnostic_classification.tolerance_only: compl1e6 may set configured converged while original strict check remains false; explicitly not a root-cause fix.
diagnostic_classification.acceleration_or_scaling_sensitivity: Single-factor strict convergence improvement with physical gates preserved is specific evidence; do not generalize to all scenes or rank performance.

limitations: No float64 Newton solver implementation; no claim of exact global precision floor.
CPU single revolute, no contact; no performance comparison because instrumentation synchronizes every iteration.
Legacy source and raw evidence immutable. All failed attempts retained; harness fixes require documented review and new fingerprint, never overwritten runs.
reviewed_by: root: source equations, observable distinctions, independent-reference gates and no post-run threshold changes
